record.question: What is basal metabolic rate (BMR)?
options: Energy used at rest for basic body functions
record.explanation: Answer C: Energy used at rest for basic body functions. Basal metabolic rate is energy expenditure under basal resting conditions to maintain essential body structure and function; it is not exercise, digestion, or total daily intake. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK591031/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
